description: Either the butter or the orange juice must end in the basket. The .bddl goal (Or ...) accepts either as sufficient. A stricter future checker could additionally require the choice to match whichever object started closer to the gripper/end-effector at episode start.
strict_variant_note: Determine 'closer at start' via initial Euclidean distance from robot0_eef_pos to butter_1 vs orange_juice_1; the expected branch is whichever is smaller.
